features.off: 해당 claim만 제거, 마지막 claim이 사라진 속성만 원래 값으로 복원; 타 owner/page 변경 보존
features.failure: FAILED/UNCONFIRMED/UNSUPPORTED를 APPLIED로 바꾸지 않음. REQUIRED 옵션 실패 시 부분 RUNNING 금지
features.spa: 초기 문서/history push/replace/pop·DOM 재생성·BFCache 복귀마다 native document/route 재검증; stale 결과 폐기

acceptance_cases.when: ON + valid sender/scope + verified frozen profile
acceptance_cases.expect: 소유한 filter 합성; DM·로그인·FOCURVE UI 제외 권장안, 영역 공동 검토
acceptance_cases.evidence: observer_ready + eligible/restricted counts + current document effect proof

acceptance_cases.when: OFF/END + same element claimed by another owner
acceptance_cases.expect: own claim removed; other claim/page state retained; final own footprint verified

acceptance_cases.when: SPA/BFCache/dynamic reinsertion/stale result/adapter failure
acceptance_cases.expect: rebind valid current doc only; no duplicate observer; stale ignored; errors never APPLIED
